lines.speaker: Eira the Keeper
lines.text: I can hear the Depths breathing from here. It never stops.

lines.speaker: Eira the Keeper
lines.text: I lost my sight in there, on the fourth floor. I found something else instead.

lines.speaker: Eira the Keeper
lines.text: Every keeper before me said the same thing: 'This time I'll make it back.' They were right. This is back.

lines.speaker: Eira the Keeper
lines.text: The archive records every soul who descends. Your name is already in it. It has been for some time.

lines.speaker: Eira the Keeper
lines.text: Go when you're ready. The Depths will be waiting regardless.
